findings.text: Only 1 of 3 passes could be measured (2 blocked). The figures come from a minority of passes and are indicative only.
During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 835 requests to 165 third-party domains (median of 1 passes).
Of 15.8 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 10.4 MB (66%) came from third-party domains, 1.2 MB of it from services classified as tracking (365 requests).

72 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: 1rx.io (RhythmOne (Magnite), advertising), 33across.com (33Across, advertising), 360yield.com (Improve Digital, advertising), 3lift.com (TripleLift, advertising), a-mo.net (AdaptMX, advertising), adform.net (Adform, advertising), adnxs.com (Microsoft (Xandr), advertising), adsrvr.org (The Trade Desk, advertising), agkn.com (Neustar (TransUnion), advertising), amazon-adsystem.com (Amazon, advertising).
349 cookies were set by third-party domains (404 cookies in total).
